method:
Decode Instruments M2 counter samples with target-only interval controls.

Instruments counter values are device-wide, not per-process. Restrict to interiors
of the 20 measured compute batches and separately exclude overlapping GPU work.
All statistics are sample means, not percentages of whole-program elapsed time.
compiler_observation_source: Xcode 27.1 GUI Shaders table and Pipeline State sidebar, manually transcribed; allocated and temporary registers are distinct displayed fields.
limitations: One isolated FFN contraction shape; not whole-model acceptance.
Xcode full replay counters and instruction sampling alter timings; do not use replay durations as speedup benchmarks.
Instruments bandwidth/cache/MMU counters that remain zero are not evidence of zero traffic; Xcode replay reports nonzero values.
Memory-wait instruction cost is not a fraction of application wall time.
The quad changes several resource demands; these data do not isolate register allocation as its only cause.
